overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.content: We are committed to protecting your personal data and ensuring transparency in how it is collected, used, and stored. This policy explains how the Weightly application processes your information, in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

dataController.title: 2. Data Controller
dataController.content: The data controller responsible for processing your personal data is:
dataController.name: Arda Sentürk

dataCollection.title: 3. Data We Collect
dataCollection.content: Depending on how you use the application, we may process the following categories of personal data:

appleHealth.title: Apple Health Data:
appleHealth.content: If granted permission by the user, relevant health-related data (e.g., weight, height, body mass index) may be accessed. This data is processed only on the user's device and is never stored on external servers.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.content: We process your personal data based on the following lawful bases:
legalBasis.consent: Consent: When you choose to connect Apple Health or create an account, we ask for your explicit consent.
legalBasis.contractual: Contractual necessity: To provide personalized weight tracking and goal features.
legalBasis.legitimate: Legitimate interest: To ensure the security and performance of the app.

storageAndSecurity.title: 5. Storage and Security
storageAndSecurity.content: If Apple Health data is not used, your weight-related data (current weight and weight goal) is stored securely on our server, along with your email, username, and optionally your age. All stored data is encrypted and protected using industry-standard security protocols. We do not share your data with third parties.

appleHealthIntegration.title: 6. Apple Health Integration
appleHealthIntegration.content: Access to Apple Health data is optional. If enabled, this data is only used locally on your device and is never transferred to our servers or external databases. You can revoke access at any time via your device settings.

userRights.title: 7. User Rights
userRights.content: As a user, you have the right to:
rights: Request deletion of your data ("Right to be Forgotten")
Withdraw your consent at any time
Request a copy of your data in a portable format
userRights.contact: To exercise your rights, contact us at: ardasnturk@me.com

dataRetention.title: 8. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain user data only for as long as necessary to provide our services or as required by law. You can delete your account and all associated data from the app at any time.

policyChanges.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
policyChanges.content: We may update this policy from time to time. Users will be notified of any significant changes through the app.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.content: If you have any questions or concerns about this policy, you can reach out to:
contact.name: Arda Sentürk
